svg.text: Every option and every state, drawn by the widget itself.
The badge and the arc colour are the state signal. Every availability row must say something different, and true.
Each mode at both ends of its range. Rail and Sections keep showing their reference bands while critical.
Ranges that are not 0..100. A DESCENDING scale (Min > Max) is supported on purpose.
